name: Root-vegetable purées (single-ingredient)

tAs.label: government read-across — India FSSAI total-As 50 for "Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods", the strictest sovereign total-arsenic ML for any food intended for infants, applied at face value across all Cat-1 subcategories (parallels the existing India infant-foods tin read-across). Because iAs ≤ tAs by identity this ceiling also bounds inorganic arsenic; where a subcategory's direct iAs ML exceeds 50 (rice) the compiler subsumes iAs under tAs.
tAs.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

tHg.label: government read-across — Israel FCS-2016 porridges & other foods for infants and toddlers, total-Hg 8 (the strictest applicable baby-food mercury ML; supersedes the looser China canned-complementary 20).
tHg.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg ≤ tHg). No jurisdiction sets a MeHg limit for this product form below the binding total mercury ceiling (8 µg/kg), so MeHg is governed by and bounded by total mercury; no separate MeHg ceiling is published.

Sn.label: government read-across (India FSSAI "Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods" Sn 5000, the only non-canned tin ML in the register) applied at face value.
Sn.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Al.label: government read-across (AU-NZ Schedule 19 infant-formula Al 500, the only government aluminium ML in any jurisdiction) applied at face value; the 8:1 reconstitution factor is formula-specific and is not applied to a non-formula product.
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr.control: Reflex Cr-VI speciation: any total-Cr result >100 ug/kg triggers Cr-VI speciation; any quantifiable Cr-VI fails. Cr-VI is never a panel number. No credible government sets a total-Cr ML for a non-dairy root-vegetable food; the dairy milk-powder read-across (China 2000) is not a defensible analogy for a non-dairy matrix.
Cr.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS hexavalent-chromium speciation (EPA 218.6 or equivalent ISO/DIN method)
Cr.rationale: Reflex Cr-VI speciation: any total-Cr result >100 ug/kg triggers Cr-VI speciation; any quantifiable Cr-VI fails. Cr-VI is never a panel number. No credible government sets a total-Cr ML for a non-dairy root-vegetable food; the dairy milk-powder read-across (China 2000) is not a defensible analogy for a non-dairy matrix.
Cr.regulatory_basis: No government maximum level for Cr in this product matrix; the toxic species is separately bounded and reflex-speciation-controlled where applicable.
Cr.jurisdictions_checked: EU; UK; CODEX; US; CA; AU-NZ; CN; IN; BR; GSO; KR; EC; MX; TR

Cr-VI.label: Hexavalent chromium is a component of total chromium (Cr-VI ≤ Cr). No jurisdiction sets a Cr-VI limit for this product form below the total chromium determination (reflex speciation: any quantifiable Cr-VI fails), so Cr-VI is governed by and bounded by total chromium; no separate Cr-VI ceiling is published.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
